caption: The drawing depicts a square textile object bordered by three distinct bands: an outer deep blue band with a subtle striped pattern, a middle band in a pale beige shade, and an inner solid royal blue band. The central panel features a scene with a large blue bird in flight toward a yellow butterfly. Below the bird, there is a small brown bird's nest with white eggs, resting on a cluster of green leaves along with red and pink flowers. To the right of the nest are additional green leaves with curling stems. On the beige border, green foliage with trailing vines appears in the upper right, while blue flowers with green stems are seen on the left. The image has a plain, cream-colored background, and the textile appears to be carefully stitched with visible threads, particularly along the borders.
title: Coverlet (Detail of Bluebird)
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
